messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Japanese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Japanese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Japanese Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (truth‑conditions) | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|------------------------------------------|--------------------|----------------------------|--------| | ove | locative adverb “where” introducing a place clause | そこでは | “there (at that place)” | OK | | udirai | future 2nd sg “you will hear” | 聞くだろう | “will hear” | OK | | le | definite article, fem. pl (marks *strida*) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | disperate | adjective “despairing” modifying *strida* | 絶望的な | “despairing” | OK | | strida | plural noun “shrieks” (object of *udirai*) | 叫び声 | “shrieks” | OK | | vedrai | future 2nd sg “you will see” | 見るだろう | “will see” | OK | | li | definite article, masc. pl (marks *spiriti*) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | antichi | adjective “ancient” modifying *spiriti* | 古代の | “ancient” | OK | | spiriti | noun “spirits” (object of *vedrai*) | 霊 | “spirits” | OK | | dolenti | adjective “woeful” describing *spiriti* | 悲しげな | “woeful” | OK | | ch'a | relative pronoun + preposition “who … to” introducing clause | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | la | definite article, fem. sg (marks *morte*) | — (omitted) | — | UNNECESSARY | | seconda | ordinal adjective “second” modifying *morte* | 第二の | “second” | OK | | morte | noun “death” (object of preposition *a*) | 死 | “death” | OK | | ciascun | distributive quantifier “each” | それぞれが | “each” | OK | | grida | verb “shouts / cries out” (predicate of relative clause) | 叫ぶ | “shout / cry out” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `le`, `li`, `la` (Italian definite articles have no lexical counterpart in Japanese). - **UNNECESSARY**: `ch'a` (the relative pronoun and preposition are expressed implicitly by the Japanese clause structure; no direct word is needed).
All other source words are rendered appropriately (OK).

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Japanese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Japanese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 115: - Original: そこではあなたは絶望的な叫び声を聞くだろう, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 116: - Original: あなたは古代の悲しげな霊を見るだろう, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 117: - Original: それぞれが第二の死に向かって叫ぶ; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
